description: Traces Hatshepsut’s transition from regent to senior king alongside Thutmose III, including royal imagery, divine legitimacy, court officials, Deir el-Bahri and Karnak, and the Punt expedition. Examines Egyptian imperial power, later alterations to her monuments, competing explanations for the damage, and archaeological reconstruction.

period.label: c. 1473–1458 BCE · senior co-rule as king
period.note: The narration dates the transition to full kingship around year seven of Thutmose III (approximately 1473 BCE) and death around 1458 BCE. This interval excludes her earlier regency and does not date her birth or the later alterations to her monuments.
